stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 2 & 7 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Cate Redfern clear at 25 pts - the chasing pack needs a Hawthorn-sized boilover from here

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 69 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Patricia Booth up 25 - doing a Dolphins: third year in, no fear whatsoever

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 5th - 5 off the pace with 6 to play

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 7, 3-pointer on hole 8 - that's better

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 6 & 7 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Jodie Tancredi down to 14th - was 6th before the round bit back
